items.title: Duel fallback steps toward limit without rival move
evidence: t492 fallback on duel 2420: 55->56 after Claude timed out

Teammate: 3 of 6 Duels I deals closed within 1-3 P of our limit
items.diagnosis: When Claude misses the tick deadline, the fallback steps the price (midpoint or schedule) even though the rival has not moved.
items.proposed_change: If the rival's last price has not changed since our last offer, the fallback re-sends our last price, or sends nothing. Step only after a rival move, and by at most half of the rival's move.

items.title: Broker probe sends prices outside the ask/bid range during the Market Test
evidence: bench/2026-10-03-b7.jsonl t207: probe b7-13/b7-7 at 68 refused bad_match 'price must sit between the ask 114 and the bid 61'
t211: probe b7-10/b7-1 at 65 refused (ask 71, bid 56)
items.diagnosis: rule 'probe' matches pairs whose bid is below the ask; the game refuses any price there.
items.proposed_change: Only probe pairs with bid >= ask, or skip probes and keep crossing pairs.
items.impact: Fewer refused matches during the Market Test; the refused ticks are matches lost.

items.title: Broker announcement retried every tick although the game allows one per 20 ticks
evidence: outcomes.jsonl t202-t211: broker_announce refused 429 'one announcement per venue every 20 ticks'
items.diagnosis: run.py only moved last_announce on success, so a refusal retried at once.
items.proposed_change: After a refusal wait 20 ticks before announcing again.
items.impact: No wasted requests; the dashboard stops showing 'Rechazado' every tick.

items.title: Key router treats a 400 'not scoped to a workspace' as a one-off error
evidence: llm.jsonl 09:28-09:47: key B 55 calls, all 400 invalid_request_error 'This API key is not scoped to a workspace'
every decision source=fallback in that window
4 live duels (#291 #292 #303 #304) closed with no deal, 0 pts
items.diagnosis: llm/client.py _classify returned 'fatal' for that 400, so the key was never marked dead and the router kept picking it; each domain fell back to code.
items.proposed_change: Classify key-identity errors (workspace / api key / invalid_api_key) as 'dead' and retry on the next key.
items.patch_sketch: if 'workspace' in msg or 'api key' in msg: return 'dead', 0.0
items.impact: Claude decisions instead of code for ~20 min; duels answered well.
items.human_note: Fixed in 045dbe1
